independence.not_claimed: Independent re-audit or fresh compilation of every dependency

checks.name: three_exports
checks.description: Exact finite profile and actual positive ordinary step semantics checked.

checks.name: width_guards
checks.description: Same-width carry 0; overflow carry 1 with leading digit 1; branches disjoint and exhaustive for physical predecessors.

checks.name: decimal_domain
checks.description: Both success branches derive the Scan digit bound from Canonical and the respective width equation.

checks.name: zero_and_singleton
checks.description: Zero source width rejected; canonical target excludes zero target/width; singleton source handled by existing Scan.

checks.name: overflow_payload
checks.description: Low payload is not required to be canonical, including the valid 5 -> 10 case.

checks.name: finite_list
checks.description: Exact length and within-width column coefficients retained; no irrelevant infinite-tail equality.

checks.name: positive_realization
checks.description: Original positive Canonical predecessor and step equality, without extra realizability hypotheses.

checks.name: scope
checks.description: Prescribed-width profile result; no uniqueness of ordinary n, fiber enumeration, or trajectory claim.
